newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo Nordisk to cut staff, service costs.
newsitem.headline: Novo Nordisk to cut staff, service costs.

text.p: Danish biotechnology group Novo Nordisk said on Thursday it planned to carry out staff and service cost cuts in both 1997 and 1998 of 400 million crowns annually.
Novo Nordisk said the cost-cutting programme was part of a project to improve work processes in its staff and service areas, initiated in early 1996.

"Some of the cost savings will be used for a further strengthening of Novo's research and development activities and sales and marketing in key growth markets in central and eastern Europe and Asia," it said in a statement.

Novo said the changes would mean a simplification and increased efficiency in internal working procedures, cuts of approximately 300 service staff and activities and a rationalisation of management structures.
It said the programme also implied a lowering of internal service levels in a number of countries and a reduction in the use of external consultants and agencies.
